items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: Lyle Ritz, and Carole... and Larry Knechtel would be playing Fender bass... They were all playing the same thing.

ctx.x: I’ve never understood how could that possibly work? Did he have someone write out the bass lines so that everybody was playing the same thing?

We’re all playing [scats]. Yeah I’m telling you, that’s the truth. Yeah. It’s all written out you know and that’s where the kind of lines, they were stupid. And we were all like this is ridiculous you know. And he had an upright bass which was Lyle Ritz, and Carole, a single Danelectro bass, a kind of weird bass, and Larry Knechtel would be playing Fender bass, and somebody else was playing guitarron and somebody else was playing another bass. They were all playing the same thing. And well whenever any one of…
When you listen to those records now if you happen to be in your car and you’ve got the oldies station on, first of all do you recognize things that you played on?
